_comment: SYNTHETIC DATA. Part 4 -> Part 5 contract. Non-personal by construction: category + coarse severity band + recommended action only. No scores, no IDs, no per-person rows. Replace with the real Part 4 output; keep key names identical.

meeting_density.caption: Team average meetings per person, by weekday and time block.

causal_categories.structural_fact: Wednesdays average 5.2 meetings per person, with no scheduled gap over 30 minutes.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Declare a protected 2-hour no-meeting block on Wednesday mornings for the whole team.

causal_categories.structural_fact: The median gap between consecutive meetings across the team is 10 minutes.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Change the calendar default to 25- and 50-minute meetings so a buffer exists by default.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 41% of recurring meetings have no agenda attached at send time.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Require an agenda field on recurring invites; auto-cancel any recurring meeting with no agenda for three cycles.

causal_categories.structural_fact: Meeting load between the lightest and heaviest quartile of the team differs by 2.3×.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Run a workload rebalancing check-in at this week's team sync — with the whole team, not selected individuals.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 18% of invites are sent outside 09:00–18:00 local time.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Turn on delayed-send defaults for invites composed after 18:00.

causal_categories.structural_fact: The longest uninterrupted block on a median day is 47 minutes.
causal_categories.recommended_action: No action needed this cycle — continue monitoring.
